Glad to know this community is here. Well, not glad that it needs to exist, but glad that it's here for those of us who need to know we aren't alone.

I've been depressed for years. I don't know what it is exactly. I worry a lot, and I'm sad a lot, and there's not always a reason. I have trouble with social situations. It could be anxiety, which my dad had for years but always confused it with depression. I guess the depression was a symptom in his case.

But I digress. I came here to find some solace in togetherness, in the face of something I know I won't be able to overcome on my own. One night, not long ago, I had some kind of panic attack in the night and after my girlfriend managed to calm me down, I decided I should call in sick and see a doctor. I have an appointment with a psychologist in mid August. Maybe that panic attack will end up being what put me on the road to recovery? I don't know.

I guess what I'm trying to say is, "Hello."
Hey guys. Another mentally unhealthy guy checking in.
Hey! I'm here for you. I get panic attacks in the night and I know THEY SUCK. Your psychologist will be great for you.

Your coffee story rocks. Depression and anxiety sucks boats, but life doesn't have to mentally unhealthy guy. :)
